Disclaimers. Tower locations are from the Tarang Sanchar registry (2022 vintage) and may undercount recent builds. Soil classification is derived from the
FAO Digital Soil Map of the World (1:5M) — a screening input only; a geotechnical survey (borehole / plate-load test) is required before foundation design.
Population figures are modelled (WorldPop 2020, 1 km grid), not a census. Fiber data covers BharatNet/BBNL public networks; urban private fiber is not
represented. This report supports planning and does not constitute engineering or legal advice.
